notes: Huntress has no syslog export; its webhooks (Integrations > Add an Integration > Webhooks) post JSON for incident reports, escalations, platform actions and account notices. An endpoint takes only a URL and the categories, and HTTP Ingest needs an Authorization: Bearer header, so put a small relay (for example a cloud function) in front of a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration: check the Svix signature Huntress sends, then forward the body unchanged with the bearer token. Incident report and escalation events (created, closed, comment added, overdue) go to the third-party alert schema; platform action and account notice events stay generic. Fields follow Huntress's public webhook payload reference. The payload has no host name, only agent_id, so look the agent up with the Huntress API when you need it. Samples are made up in the reference's schemas. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (91 of 91 fields matched the emulator). No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests. The engine replaces an event time in the future with the ingest time.
